Dutch Parliamentary Behaviour Dataset (Questions)

Source: R/datasets.R
examplequestions.Rd

Written questions from Members of the Dutch lower house, asked 4-5 January 2010, with cabinet, election and party information from REPDEM (and ParlGov for 1918-1946).

Usage

data(examplequestions)

Format

A questionList object

Details

The object has class c("questionListRepdem", "questionList"). Besides metaList, questionerList, responderList, categoryList and questionText, it contains the same cabinet, election and party tables as examplevotes, with questionCabinet (cabinet and caretaker status at the date of the response) in place of voteCabinet.

See also

examplequestions_legacy for the same questions with ParlGov data.
